hotels.title: Stylish Grand Mercure Batam Centre Escape in the Heart of Batam
hotels.description: Discover polished waterfront style at this contemporary Batam stay, set in Batam Centre just moments from Batam Centre Point International Ferry Terminal and Mega Mall. Sleek rooms and suites pair modern comforts with views across the city or sea, placing you close to the island’s key transport links and shopping precincts. Spend afternoons by the outdoor pool, keep to your routine at the fitness centre or dine on Indonesian and international fare at the hotel’s restaurant. Nearby, visit the grand Maha Vihara Duta Maitreya Temple or head to Harbour Bay for fresh seafood dinners overlooking the strait
